bio.short: Software Development Engineer specializing in React 19, Node.js, and modern full-stack architectures. BCA undergraduate at Manipal University (6th Semester).
bio.medium: Naveen Kumar is a Software Development Engineer and final-year BCA student at Manipal University (6th semester). He is passionate about crafting ultra-responsive web applications, resilient backend microservices, and delightful developer tooling. He specializes in React 19, Node.js, modern CSS/animations, and strong computer science fundamentals in Java & DSA.
bio.long: As a Software Development Engineer and BCA student at Manipal University (entering 6th semester), Naveen Kumar bridges the gap between sophisticated UI engineering and scalable backend infrastructure. With deep proficiency across the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem, Node.js, React 19, and Java-based algorithmic foundations, Naveen builds end-to-end digital experiences ranging from developer CLI tools (create-naveen-react) and cloud music players (Cloudbeat) to multi-tenant SaaS platforms and 3D creative web experiments. He prioritizes clean code, high runtime performance, and intuitive user experiences.
bio.markdown:
# Naveen Kumar
**Software Development Engineer (SDE)** | BCA @ Manipal University (6th Sem)

- 🚀 **Full-Stack Mastery**: React 19, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript
- 🎨 **Creative & UI Engineering**: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, 3D Web Canvas
- 🧠 **CS Foundations**: Java, Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Architecture
- 🛠️ **Developer Experience**: Custom CLI toolchains (`create-naveen-react`), Monorepo architectures

projects.title: create-naveen-react CLI
projects.tagline: Modern CLI tool for instant, zero-friction React application scaffolding with curated production defaults
projects.description: An automated developer tool designed to bootstrap production-ready React applications with preconfigured Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, animations, and modern bundler tooling in seconds.
highlights: Eliminated 90% of boilerplate setup time for modern frontend projects
Configured with dynamic template selection and intelligent package manager detection
Includes out-of-the-box support for Tailwind CSS v4 and Framer Motion

projects.title: Cloudbeat & Web Music Suite
projects.tagline: Next-generation cloud-connected audio player and dynamic playlist manager
projects.description: A high-fidelity web music streaming and audio management application featuring real-time playback visualizations, responsive controls, playlist caching, and low-latency audio pipelines.
highlights: Engineered smooth 60fps audio waveform visualizations with canvas & Web Audio API
Integrated seamless state persistence for continuous background playback
Designed dark-mode UI with tactile micro-interactions

projects.title: SaaS Platform Engine

Implemented token-based authentication and secure session management
Built responsive metrics & monitoring dashboards

projects.title: Life Memory App

Client-side media compression and offline-first storage sync
Custom tag filtering and memory search engine
